notablePrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped.
description:
Activate Meloku the Clouded Mirror by paying {1} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 blue Illusion creature token with flying.
When the Illusion enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, allowing you to put the same land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
